items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: That playing with the foot and Mike Ratton and all those guys are getting credit.

ctx.x: Can you tell me a little bit more about him?
All that stuff I do is for my brother Henny. That playing with the foot and Mike Ratton and all those guys are getting credit. My brother was the first one to do that.
